nom: Bubble Water Slide Hydration Boosting Serum Hyaluronic Acid + Peptides

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one with oily and sensitive skin and rosacea, report the serum hydrates without adding greasiness, though one uses it only at night to manage this.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin repeatedly credit the serum with relieving dry patches, winter dryness and flaking and leaving skin softer, though two reviewers with dry skin say it did not fix their dry patches or left skin feeling less hydrated afterward.
segments.combination: One reviewer describes combination skin shifting with weather (drier in cold, oilier in heat) and says the serum helps in both conditions.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it is gentle, calming and non-irritating, but others report stinging, itching, tingling, redness or bumps, including one explicit warning to sensitive-skin users.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 40s reports a continual, noticeable improvement in skin softness after her skin changed with age.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-dry skin and a slightly oily nose reports it works well and leaves skin glowy and soft.

concerns.aging: One reviewer in her 40s reports a noticeable, ongoing improvement in skin quality attributed to the serum.
concerns.dehydration: The great majority of reviewers, across skin types, report strong hydration, plumpness and a dewy finish; a minority say the effect was unremarkable or faded quickly, and one felt less hydrated afterward.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the serum helps with her redness; another with oily, sensitive, rosacea-prone skin reports good tolerance without added redness, while a different reviewer reports the product made her skin red and bumpy.
concerns.barrier: Two reviewers credit the serum with strengthening or supporting the skin barrier, citing ceramides as a reason for tolerance with other actives.
concerns.spots: One very young reviewer mentions developing acne around her nose and cheeks and is seeking guidance rather than reporting a clear effect from this product.
concerns.blemishes: Most who mention blemishes report no new breakouts and some report clearer or acne-safe use even on acne-prone skin, but one reviewer explicitly says the product seems to be breaking her out with redness and bumps, and another noticed a pimple after use though attributed it uncertainly.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the serum hydrates without making skin oilier, with one specifying she applies it at night to avoid daytime shine.

extraits.texte: I have very dry sensitive skin for starters, but i saw a makeup artist on tiktok use this in her routine to achieve a flawless base, lots of people submitted their photos doing it and they all looked amazing! So i thought I'd try it, ITCHYYY SKINNNN and tingling as soon as i apply it. Additionally, I don't think this has helped with hydration at all, as I still have very apparent dry skin patches. I know no serum is a miracle worker but even my Good Molecules hydrating serum tends to help with them. This hasn't helped with my dryness at all. But aside from that more importantly, this makes my skin tingle and itchy. Not a fan :/

I wanted to like this, but i think its breaking me out. I've noticed now every time i wear it my skin gets red and bumpy. It does make you look glowy which is great. Just doesnt work for everyone. Try at your own risk.

I loveeeee this product, it's very hydrating and helps with my redness. BUT, I did notice a pimple under my eye after?? It could be this product or another one I used… I dunno! Also, this is totally unrelated but I'm 12yrs old and I'm starting to have acne around my nose and cheeks, so I'm trying skincare products! IF BUBBLE COULD REACH OUT (respond to this message) out and tell me what I should use that would be great. I have sensitive, pimples, dry, and semi-red skin on my cheeks and nose!!
I have oily sensitive skin with some rosacea and my skin loves this serum. It gives my skin good hydration without making it oily.

extraits.titre: a need is your acne safe skincare routine.
extraits.texte: i have never tried bubble products and was always scared to because of my extremely acne prone skin. upon buying this, i had over exfoliated skin, extremely drehydrated, while still combatting clogged pores all over the lower half of my cheeks. i need hydration immediately but had no idea where to start. one day i said f it. i bought this serum without having seen any reviews or videos on tiktok and i'm in love. the hydrated and plump look this gives me…… chefs kiss. i need multiple bottles of this now because i'm OBSESSED. i want to try the new cosmic silk but that'll have to wait. as for now, this serum is a need.
